reuse.why: All month-wide consumers share getMonthWideCategories, and the change reuses existing tag parsing, sheet access, budget writes, batching and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: The repeated category queries are consolidated, although the new action repeats the income eligibility guard already present in the other actions.

placement.why: Category eligibility and budget calculations stay in budget/actions.ts, while handler registration stays in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: The shared selector and argument type make future eligibility changes straightforward, although income eligibility remains distributed across consumers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every affected month-wide action calls getMonthWideCategories, and the new action uses the existing infrastructure helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining repeated income guards are explicit; the category selection logic is actually consolidated.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories boolean and a conditional hidden-filter branch; all six month-wide consumers use it.
